name: acs/order-resend-changed
description: 2.0. An external_order_id sent again: the identical request replays the original order (202, same command_key, nothing dispatched again); the same ID with a different request is 409 ErrIdempotencyKeyReused. Before 2.0 the second case answered 202 with the original order.
captured_from: RECORDED from a running ACS (cmd/api + cmd/bssadapter + Postgres) at commit c9c94ff, 2026-11-15. Secrets and tokens redacted.

body.title: Idempotency key reused
body.detail: this external_order_id was already used for a different request; the original order stands. Send a changed order under a new external_order_id
